display_long_description:
**FAQ & support on our Discord:** https://discord.gg/D7AwRvu8U9 

Dance of Drauganna is a narrative VR rhythm-dance game that fuses electronic music, choreography, and immersive storytelling into a single, continuous experience of transformation.

Players arrive on a mysterious island as a soul without a body. There, shadow figures become gateways into different forms of existence—from insects and aquatic creatures to microorganisms, robots, and alien beings. To move forward, players must dance and dancing means becoming.
[media]

Each life form has its own unique choreography, developed with professional dancers and captured through motion capture, making every transformation physically distinct. Players might skitter like an insect, drift like an aquatic creature, or move with the precision of a machine.

Gameplay is driven by an original electronic score featuring artists including Max Cooper, Modeselektor, Dasha Rush, and Flying Lotus. Players follow rhythmic cues to bring the world around them to life. Completing each dance unlocks the next form, revealing an ongoing cycle of creation, transformation, and interconnectedness.
[media]
Dance of Drauganna isn't about defeating enemies or collecting rewards. It's about becoming—again and again—until the boundaries between self and other, human and non-human, body and world begin to dissolve.
[media]
[media]
